facts.fact: CAMTEL said on 2026-06-09 that its Zamengoe Data Centre is the largest in Central Africa and Tier III certified (operator claim via a PR-wire outlet, no certifier named); the document presents it as serving government data and does not state outside rental.

CAMTEL said at the SAGO conference of 9 June 2026 that its Zamengoe Data Centre is a critical national asset ensuring the security, continuity and local control of government data; the document does not list the specific systems hosted.

note: carried from datacentres; no document opened
